LanguageData.RP_IntelHint_Rumours: No rumours. A cell search, a transfer, a death, the yard called off or an early lockup, a restriction, a food scare, a strike or a send to supermax can start talk on the wing it touches, and talk spreads at meals and in the yard.
LanguageData.RP_IntelTip_Rumour:
The {0} wing is saying "{1}" ({2}). Strength {3}%, how much of the wing has heard it as it fades over {4} days.
Every inmate of the wing is wound up by it while it runs, a twisted version more than the plain facts. A calm address in the wing's canteen (heard by at least two of the wing) ends a false rumour at once and halves a true one (a true rumour is never talked away). A firm address makes either stick for {5} more day(s), once. Walking the wing finds who started it, and a known informant may tell you. Or let it burn out.
LanguageData.RP_Rumour_StartedByUnknown: who started it is not known
LanguageData.RP_IntelRumourCalmTip: The warden goes to the canteen where the {0} wing is and speaks calmly to whoever is there. A false rumour ends at once, a true one loses half its strength.
LanguageData.RP_IntelRumourFirmTip: The warden goes to the canteen where the {0} wing is and speaks firmly. The quiet is bought, and the rumour sticks for {1} more day(s).
LanguageData.RP_IntelRumourWalkTip: The warden walks the {0} wing. Those met say who started the talk.
LanguageData.RP_Rumour_NoWingZone: The {0} wing is not painted, so there is nowhere to walk.
